subject: Pen test sprint: access constraints, window extension & deliverable finalization
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@bluefortsec.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Cc: BlueFort Sec <engagements@bluefortsec.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Redwood PT engagement (SOW v2 attached)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — attaching the updated SOW (BlueFort_PT_SOW_v2.pdf) and a short checklist of access items. We reviewed the high-level inventory you sent and have two clarifying questions before we finalize the scan plan: 

1) For production hosts, is there a restricted testing window (hours we should avoid) and any services that are strictly out-of-scope?
2) Do you prefer VPN-based bastion access or temporary cloud IAM roles (we can support both; roles are easier for logging).

To prepare, we also need a machine-readable environment inventory (CSV) with FQDNs, IPs, and environment tags (dev/stage/prod). You can drop that in the Drive link or reply with the file.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 1 Dec 2026 — low-intensity daytime scans + targeted auth testing the first two days, ramping up overnight as agreed. We can compress the schedule but want to confirm the safe windows up-front.

If you can confirm by EOD Friday (27 Nov) we’ll lock the calendar and send the engagement credentials template.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Senior Engagement Manager | BlueFort Security
attachments: BlueFort_PT_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW), engagement_checklist.txt

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@bluefortsec.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Redwood PT engagement (SOW v2 attached)

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. A few points from our side: 

- Production safe window: we need daytime production stability; please avoid any intrusive testing on prod between 08:00-17:00 PT Mon-Fri. You may do non-intrusive discovery and auth checks during that time but no load tests or exploit attempts.
- Stated out-of-scope services: internal CI/CD runners and payroll systems are out-of-scope (we flagged these in the env inventory).
- Access method: we prefer temporary IAM roles for the cloud-hosted services and an SSH bastion for on-prem boxes. Priyom (cc'd) will create the temporary role and a service account for API auth.

Attached: redwood_env_inventory.csv (lightweight inventory) — this is missing a couple of hostnames we will add by EOD Friday.

We can agree to the 1 Dec kickoff but need to confirm a minor schedule request: BlueFort mentioned a report delivery by 5 Dec in SOW v2; with the extended auth testing we may need the final report by 7 Dec. Can you confirm if that is acceptable?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Programs | Redwood Inference
phone: +1-415-555-0123
attachments: redwood_env_inventory.csv

From: Elena Rossi <elena@bluefortsec.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Cc: BlueFort Sec <engagements@bluefortsec.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Redwood PT engagement (SOW v2 attached)

Marissa — appreciate the clarifications. Confirming: 

- We will avoid intrusive actions on prod during 08:00-17:00 PT Mon-Fri. We will perform credentialed, low-intensity checks in that window where needed and reserve exploit validation for agreed overnight slots.
- Out-of-scope items noted.
- IAM roles are fine — we will submit a role assumption template in the next email.

Regarding the report delivery: moving the final report to 07 Dec is fine on our end given the slight scope increase, but we will require interim findings (high-risk items) to be shared within 24 hours of discovery via the Slack channel you provided. This keeps remediation cycles tight.

One additional ask: the inventory CSV is missing the internal jump hosts and a few Kubernetes node IPs. Could you please update and re-send? I’ve added inline comments to the checklist.

Quoted for context: 
> On Thu, 26 Nov 2026, marissa_cole wrote:
> > Attached: redwood_env_inventory.csv (lightweight inventory) — this is missing a couple of hostnames we will add by EOD Friday.

Best,
Elena
attachments: engagement_role_template.txt

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff — Redwood PT engagement (SOW v2 attached)

Folks — forwarding the vendor's confirmation. Key asks: agree to extend final report date to 07 Dec and provide the missing jump hosts + k8s node IPs; Priyom, please provision the temporary IAM role and a service account with limited read/auth test permissions by EOD Mon (30 Nov).

Context: BlueFort will do daytime low-intensity checks and overnight exploit validation. We need to restrict prod intrusive tests to overnight and ensure vendor will report critical findings immediately. This is tied to SEC-4321 (link below). Please reply with any objections or constraints.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Fwd: Kickoff — Redwood PT engagement (SOW v2 attached)

Thanks for the forward. I’m okay with a 07 Dec final delivery given the scope uptick — approve the extension. A couple of operational asks: 

- Limit production intrusive testing to a single overnight window (00:30–04:30 PT) and run a canary on a non-critical subset first.
- BlueFort must sign our standard POA and data handling addendum before they start; Legal can cut turnarounds but I want confirmation before credentials are issued.
- Priyom — please create the temporary service account + IAM role and post credentials to the secured Drive folder; rotate keys on 10 Dec as planned.

No objections from me otherwise. Marissa, once Legal confirms POA I’ll give the green light to share the jump host details.

-Vivek
VP, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@bluefortsec.com>, BlueFort Sec <engagements@bluefortsec.com>, Tom Wallace <tom@customerco.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodai.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Redwood PT engagement (SOW v2 attached) — Confirmed schedule and access

Elena/Tom — final confirmation from our side: 

- Kickoff: 01 Dec 2026. BlueFort will perform low-intensity daytime discovery and credentialed checks. 
- Prod intrusive window: 00:30–04:30 PT on 03–04 Dec 2026 (single overnight window). Vendor to run canary on the first hour against a non-critical subset and pause on any instability.
- Interim findings: share high/critical results to #sec-pt-high via Slack within 24 hours of discovery. Final consolidated report due 07 Dec 2026.
- Legal/POA: we require a signed POA and data handling addendum before privileged credentials are issued — please confirm signature status.
- Access: Priyom will upload the role assumption ARN, temporary service account, and SSH bastion username to the secure Drive folder 
(https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c) by 30 Nov EOD. See SEC-4321 for tracking and remediation tickets.

Attachments provided: access_instructions.txt (bastion + role details) and redwood_env_inventory.csv (finalized).

If that matches your plan, Elena, please reply to confirm and we’ll circulate the calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Programs | Redwood Inference
attachments: access_instructions.txt, redwood_env_inventory.csv
